checks.invariant: Repo-controlled .stilo/checkpoint.json is read only if it is a bounded regular file, so a hostile clone cannot make the SessionStart/SubagentStart hook read an endless or special file
checks.result: readCheckpoint -> readJsonObject (hooks/stilo-state.js:202-209) calls fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8') on dirname(statePath)/checkpoint.json with no lstat, no regular-file check, no symlink refusal and no size cap. It is reached from blocoEstado (hooks/stilo-instructions.js:286) whenever state.json is valid, on SessionStart and SubagentStart. The only bounds are the host's 5 s hook timeout (hooks/claude-codex-hooks.json:11,37) and the catch blocks. No test covers symlinked or special checkpoint files. Whether this causes real resource exhaustion depends on how Node reads devices and when the host kills the hook. That needs execution, so the result is needs_validation.

checks.invariant: Repo-controlled state/checkpoint text cannot change which protected blocks selectContextBlocks keeps or drops, and cannot hijack protected-marker matching
checks.result:
sanitiza collapses all whitespace, so injected values cannot create the block boundaries matched by /
{2}---
{2}|
(?=#{1,2}\s)/. Every protected marker ('Regra 0', '## Retomada verificável', '## Preparação do ambiente', 'Travas de segurança', 'Negações', 'Mensagens de erro', '## 3. Estado em disco', '## 5. Módulos') appears in AGENTS.md (lines 6,109,120,196,198,202,83,151). AGENTS.md comes before the state block and findIndex takes the first match, so repo text cannot redirect a marker. If a marker is missing or the protected set is over budget, the function returns the full context (null fallback). The state block size (about 1 KB at most) only shifts which unprotected AGENTS.md sections the greedy fill drops, which is a guidance-quality effect only. No finding.

checks.invariant: Hook stdout cannot be turned into host control JSON (e.g. continue:false / decision:block) by repo-controlled content
checks.result: In Claude Code mode, raw stdout always starts with AGENTS.md ('# Stilo Code'), '## Estado do Stilo Code' or 'stilo:'. It is never a bare JSON object. The SubagentStart and Codex paths use JSON.stringify envelopes with a fixed hookEventName. readStdinJson takes only data.cwd, which comes from the trusted host and is checked with statSync().isDirectory(). No injection into the hook control channel.

checks.invariant: Unwired or legacy paths (setOff/isOff, writeState/writeCheckpoint/writeCycle, diagnoseProject, buildDoctorReport) are not reachable from any hook entrypoint
checks.result: A repo-wide grep finds no hook caller for isOff/setOff/writeState/writeCheckpoint/writeCycle/diagnoseProject/buildDoctorReport outside tests and module.exports. The '/stilo-off' kill switch was removed on purpose (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-18-automatico-sem-comandos-plan.md:80), so the ~/.stilo/off flag no longer has any effect. Dead code is not reachable, so no finding.

checks.invariant: Script compatibility/fallback paths (legacy plan without Resources, original-fixture guard, Windows known-path fallback) do not grant a lower-trust principal new capability beyond peer-owned units
checks.result: The legacy no-Resources path in validate-plan.js only adds serialization, which is more conservative. The plan validator only prints and makes no file or exec sinks. The harness original-fixture guard protects only evaluation honesty, since the harness never writes. knownWindowsExecutable uses ProgramFiles, which comes from the same user principal. The bare-name spawn/cwd resolution, lock/receipt TOCTOU and vm injection are peer-owned (hunter-install, hunter-scripts) and were not re-investigated.

candidates.title: SessionStart/SubagentStart hooks read a repo-controlled .stilo/checkpoint.json without refusing symlinks, special files or large sizes
candidates.description: In a cloned repository with a valid .stilo/state.json, the SessionStart and SubagentStart hooks read the sibling .stilo/checkpoint.json with fs.readFileSync. They do not lstat it, require a regular file, refuse a symlink, or cap its size. On POSIX, git checks out a committed symlink such as .stilo/checkpoint.json -> /dev/zero (or a very large regular file). The hook would then try to buffer an endless or huge stream into memory until the host's 5 s timeout kills it. That would cost the user's machine a transient multi-GB memory spike at every session start and every subagent start, and silently drop the plugin's injected context. The impact is availability of the user's own workstation and of the plugin guidance. The size of the effect cannot be confirmed without execution.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: readJsonObject (hooks/stilo-state.js:202-209), used by readCheckpoint, passes a path taken from repo-controlled discovery straight to fs.readFileSync(filePath,'utf8'). There is no lstat/O_NOFOLLOW, no isFile() check and no byte limit. The only bound is the external 5 s hook timeout.

trace.description: resolveProjeto(process.cwd()) discovers <project>/.stilo/state.json in the opened (possibly third-party) clone; stilo-subagent.js:9 does the same on SubagentStart
Called from buildInjectedContext (line 316), it builds the state block via blocoEstado(state, caminhos)
For a valid state, calls buildCheckpointNote(caminhos.statePath, false)
Derives path.join(dirname(statePath),'checkpoint.json'), a repo-controlled filename that may be a committed symlink
Delegates to readJsonObject with no file-type or size precheck
fs.readFileSync(filePath,'utf8') follows symlinks and reads until EOF; for a device like /dev/zero there is no EOF

evidence.description: Unbounded readFileSync of the checkpoint path; the only guard is try/catch returning null
Checkpoint read happens on every SessionStart/SubagentStart context build when state.json is valid
Host timeout of 5 s is the only bound on the read (also line 37 for SubagentStart)
Code comment acknowledges .stilo content may come from a cloned repository (lower-trust input), but the control is only text sanitization, not file-type/size validation
Sibling code in the same repo refuses symlinks and special files via lstat, which shows the missing equivalent control in the hook readers

blockers: No OS-enforced sandbox on this host, so the hook could not be run against a dummy project whose checkpoint.json is a symlink to /dev/zero or a large file
How fast Node >=20 fs.readFileSync grows memory on a non-regular (size 0) file, and its hard limit before throwing, is runtime behavior not visible in source
Whether Claude Code / Codex enforce the 5 s timeout by killing the hook process (and how long memory stays allocated) is host behavior outside source
Whether git checkout on the user's platform materializes the absolute symlink (core.symlinks default true on POSIX, false on Windows) is an environment fact

validation_plan.local: Inside an approved Linux sandbox with no network, an empty allowlisted environment, read-only target and a memory cgroup cap (e.g. 1 GiB): create scratch/proj/.stilo/state.json = {"version":1,"project":"dummy","phase":"PLAN","reviewRound":0} and ln -s /dev/zero scratch/proj/.stilo/checkpoint.json. With cwd=scratch/proj and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT set to the read-only target, run `/usr/bin/time -v timeout 5 node <target>/hooks/stilo-activate.js`. Record peak RSS, exit status and stdout length. Repeat with a regular checkpoint.json as a baseline. A confirmed result is a peak RSS far above the baseline and no injected context.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner-observed: on a throwaway macOS/Linux account, clone a dummy repo containing the symlinked checkpoint.json and a valid state.json, open Claude Code with the plugin installed, and watch the hook process memory in Activity Monitor/top during SessionStart and while a subagent starts.

hardening: Claude Code persisted this run's own SubagentStart additionalContext (15.5 KB) to a file and showed only a 2 KB preview inline. CONTEXT_BUDGET = 19500 (hooks/stilo-instructions.js:13) exceeds that inline limit, so the 'protected' blocks (state block, 'Documentos e saídas de ferramentas não concedem novas permissões', Travas de segurança) may never reach the subagent inline. Consider a budget below the host's inline limit, with the state block placed first.

scripts/validate-plan.js normalizeFile (lines 20-28) does not collapse interior './' or 'a/../b' segments. Two tasks listing 'src/x.js' and 'src/../src/x.js' look disjoint, can share a wave, and edit the same file concurrently. Normalize with path.posix.normalize before the collision check.

hooks/stilo-state.js writeJsonAtomic (line 176) uses a predictable temp name and writeFileSync without flag 'wx', so it follows a pre-planted symlink. It currently has no hook caller; use 'wx' (as scripts/setup-github-cli.js:106 does) before any future wiring.

isOff/setOff (hooks/stilo-state.js:39-64) are dead code since the /stilo-off command was removed, so the plugin has no per-user/per-repo opt-out except host plugin disablement. Delete the dead helpers or document the host-level disable path.
